title: Rice
body:
"how was this seriously the most suggested item in the past 3 months???"

Description

Rice is a decoration item that was added to Oaklands in a secret Friday update in version 1.34.0. It can be purchased at the Radical Shack for $600.

Trivia

  • As the items description read, Rice was the most requested item to be added into the game, as it had been asked to be added for more than 3 months.
